item.title: Inside MITA's war room where cyberattacks are detected and repelled
item.description: MaltaToday visited the Malta Information Technology Agency's security operations centre in Santa Venera, the body tasked with safeguarding the state's IT infrastructure. A MITA agent said no country or organisation can eliminate cyberattack risk, and that the objective is to reduce risk, detect malicious activity early, respond effectively and recover services quickly. Ransomware, phishing, social engineering, credential theft and insider risks were identified as the key concerns, with national incident-response arrangements also being strengthened.
item.content:encoded:
MaltaToday visited the Malta Information Technology Agency's security operations centre in Santa Venera, the body tasked with safeguarding the state's IT infrastructure. A MITA agent said no country or organisation can eliminate cyberattack risk, and that the objective is to reduce risk, detect malicious activity early, respond effectively and recover services quickly. Ransomware, phishing, social engineering, credential theft and insider risks were identified as the key concerns, with national incident-response arrangements also being strengthened.

Sources: Malta Today
